description: Add a UV sphere to the current Blender scene. Use the Add menu (Shift+A or Add > Mesh > UV Sphere) to add a sphere. Position the sphere at approximately (0, -3, 2) in 3D space. The sphere should have a radius of about 1 unit. After adding the sphere, save the file to '/home/ga/BlenderProjects/scene_with_sphere.blend'.
